correctness.rationale: The three pairings exhaust the complex lines: on a line the four coordinate restrictions are binary linear forms. Fifth powers of up to four projectively distinct nonzero binary forms are independent by the Vandermonde identity in characteristic zero (choose coordinates with nonzero first coefficient). Thus in the Fermat equation each proportionality class must have at least two nonzero members. Because the restrictions span two dimensions, there are exactly two classes of two, and each ratio has fifth power −1. Within a family the intersections are precisely the row/column matches. For two different families the four coordinates form one cycle of nonzero ratios; a projective solution exists exactly when the cycle product is 1. This both verifies the symbolic equations and permits the faithful reduction of the order-ten ratio group to F_11. I reconstructed each line by its twelve normalized F_11 projective points, independently tested intersections by set overlap, and calculated the exact characteristic polynomial, integer cofactor determinant, and direct integer Smith form. They give degree 18, 675 edges, connectedness, and the claimed 74 factors 1×26,5×11,15×13,60,300×12,1500×9,7500×2, with product 2^48·3^37·5^84. The claimed five-adic profile follows directly. The archived local pivot argument is valid at the specified precision, greater than the total determinant valuation at each prime.
residual_risks: Characteristic-zero completeness is not inferred from the finite-field model. This check does not establish an analogous claim for all lines in special reduction.

value.rationale: The simple intersection graph of all lines of the canonical complex quintic is intrinsically defined. Its precise integral chip-firing quotient gives the exponent and distinguishes elements of orders 5,25,125,625, even after the determinant and number of 5-primary generators are known. These are useful data for integral divisor and symmetry calculations on this graph, not extra terminology for its rational spectrum or a Picard calculation.
residual_risks: A complete exact invariant for one natural graph, not a degree-uniform Smith theorem or a claim about the quintic’s surface divisor class group.
